footer.marks: Harness names and marks belong to their owners and are used only to identify the tools Skopli reads.
harness.col.name: Harness
harness.note.sessions: One event per session, not per turn: the harness stores only a per-session cumulative total. Skopli still includes sessions whose totals are marked estimated.
harness.note.estimated: Token counts are estimated from stored message length (about four characters per token). Treat these totals as estimates, not billed usage.
harness.note.perModel: One event per model per session: the harness stores real provider counts per model, not per turn. Skopli reads every session regardless of its billing state.
